Info

Encapsulates logger runtime components for simplification of the logger bundle.

class ats_utilities.logger.setup.bundle.LoggerBundle(*, logger: IUnderlyingLogger, has_file_handler: bool, formatter: ILogFormatter, buffer: ILogBuffer, handler_manager: ILogHandlerManager, message_processor: IMessageProcessor)[source]¶

Bases: object

Encapsulates logger runtime components for simplification of the logger bundle.

It defines:

attributes:
logger - The logger.
has_file_handler - The flag indicating if the logger has a file handler.
formatter - The formatter for log messages.
buffer - The buffer for early log messages.
handler_manager - The handler manager for log output.
message_processor - The message processor for log messages.
methods:
to_dict - Converts the logger bundle to a dictionary.
